    Stable paths in the BGRS ray category #

    BGRS stability is occurrence-sensitive: every occurrence of an arrow in a path may be represented independently inside its unit ray. This file records those representative sequences and proves the source's fundamental characterization: a path is stable exactly when its composite ray is nonzero.

    The reverse implication uses the BGRS pair dichotomy. In the exceptional product branch, its zero representatives can be absorbed into the last arrow occurrence, so no global consistency assumption on repeated arrows is needed.
